notes: Labeled "Sonnet 5.6 (next)" by the repo owner, who believes requests for claude-sonnet-5-5 were being routed to a newer model at the time. Every run reported claude-sonnet-5-5 as the executed model. Before the prompt, the session answered one short no-tools question the repo owner uses to check which model is answering. The prompt was written by an orchestrating Claude Opus 5.5 session that only prompted; all code is from Sonnet sessions. The run was staged: the brief reached the agent in five messages over the session, merged here into one prompt.md. The pedestrians were built by a second claude-sonnet-5-5 session at xhigh, in its own test project from a separate brief, over about 2.5 hours in parallel; the main session integrated its package. The first message also gave machine setup (Windows 11, the UE 5.8.4 install and its plugins, Visual Studio with C++, ffmpeg, Python with a venv, the GPU and free disk), which prompt.md leaves out. A one-hour deadline near the end cut the final renders from 8 to 4 temporal samples. In this repo: the films are 1920x1080 re-encodes of the 4K masters, because the masters and the agent's X copies are over GitHub's 100 MB file limit; stills are downscaled to 1920 px JPEG; the destruction sheet is a JPEG of the original PNG; the Unreal Content folder and the per-tool before/after audit stills are left out. source/, NYC/ and tools/ hold the agent's code; source/pipeline.py regenerates the content.
